buildAndUpgradeTrigger: mouse release handling timestamp to first matching frame_post_draw; OS event delivery before handler is excluded

fixture.setup: public planner plus strict codec roundtrip; setup excluded from sampled windows

focusSampling: DisplayServer.window_is_focused and window_get_mode at each frame_post_draw
frameBoundary: wall-clock interval between actual frame_post_draw callbacks; includes CPU, GPU, scheduling and instrumentation
frameClock: frameEndsUsec uses Time.get_ticks_usec; C# phase durations use Stopwatch, with no common absolute epoch or frame-to-phase attribution
inputCadence: wall-clock pacing at most 60 Hz, with no catch-up bursts; pan/hover pair targets 120 motion events per second
passMeaning: fixture, input and measurement integrity only; latency and frame targets are reported independently

polylineView.purpose: separate region of 11 canonical L chains; fixture is representative, not a high-chain-point worst case

scope: 240-edge current-admission Debug baseline; not a 10K-edge or stable-144-FPS acceptance
warmupScope: render/idle warmup; first operation includes any remaining cold planner/JIT cost
